rspamd.nix. Watched leaf (extraArgs) restored to historical option_not_found->predicate_not_found (a genuine correction, same root-cause class as the 7 F1-R regressions). Residual: 11 entries missing from discovered_options (bindSockets, count, includes, mode, name, owner, rawEntry, socket, source, text, type). Traced: `workers = mkOption { type = with types; attrsOf (submodule workerOpts); ... };` -- a LOCAL `with types;` wraps this reference. workerOpts itself (which declares bindSockets, count, includes, ... among its own leaves) is never promoted because of this local with-scope refusal; bindSocketOpts (nested a further hop inside workerOpts's own now-unwalked content) never even becomes a candidate as a result. Same root-cause-A mechanism as the prosody/tayga cases -- this PR mixes a genuine same-root-cause-class verdict restoration with a genuine unexpected discovery delta; classified unexpected_candidate_semantic_delta because the mandate requires treating any unexplained-as-pre-existing discovery gap this way, not because the watched verdict itself regressed.

portmaster.nix. Watched leaf verdict is historical-identical (unaffected). Residual: 7 entries missing (directory, name, package, storeNameRegex, strictHead, strictLast, wrapped). Traced a DIFFERENT, second mechanism (not a `with`-wrap): `profiles = mkOption { type = attrsOf (submodule ({name,...}: {options = {...; packages = mkOption { type = listOf profilePackageType; ...}; };})); };` is a real true-root declaration with an INLINE submodule type; `packages`'s own type references `profilePackageType`, a named let-binding whose OWN value is `types.coercedTo types.package (package: {inherit package;}) packageMatchType` -- itself referencing a SECOND named binding, `packageMatchType` (the actual submodule declaring directory/name/package/storeNameRegex/strictHead/strictLast/wrapped). collect_type_reference_ranges resolves `profilePackageType`'s own reference (added to `referenced`) but does not recursively scan `profilePackageType`'s OWN value for further identifier references, so `packageMatchType` -- referenced only indirectly, through profilePackageType -- never gets added to `referenced` and is never promoted. This is a genuine 'true root -> legitimate intermediate -> legitimate submodule B' case, exactly the shape the mandate's own single-hop check anticipated, though the mechanism is a non-recursive alias scan rather than the one-hop promotion cap itself.

Under F1B's two-pass architecture, these four entries belong to a promoted (Pass 2) named submodule and are appended to the output AFTER all of Pass 1's true-root content, rather than interleaved in their original source-document position (which is what the historical, single-pass, unconditional-walk binary produced). Classified unexpected_candidate_semantic_delta, not non_semantic_representation_delta, because in the presence of a real (pre-existing) duplicate-path collision, a vector-order change IS evidence of discovery behavior that could flip which duplicate `run_target`'s own gate-1 `.find()` selects for a different, hypothetical watched query against 'enable' specifically -- directly relevant to the separately disclosed leaf-collision edge case, not merely cosmetic.

frigate.nix. Watched leaf ('path', inside cameraFormat.ffmpeg.inputs) is historical-identical (OptionNotFound both sides, unaffected -- confirmed already in the S5-F1B round's own completion report). Residual: 3 entries missing (ffmpeg.inputs, ffmpeg.inputs.path, ffmpeg.inputs.roles), all from cameraFormat, a named let-binding. Root cause: the file's own TRUE-ROOT declaration itself, `options.services.frigate = with types; { ... };`, is wrapped in `with types;` at the point walk_merge_operands would need to unwrap it -- walk_merge_operands only unwraps a literal attrset or a `//`-merge, not a `with` expression. This is a pre-existing, unrelated gap (predates F1 entirely -- Pass 1 never even discovers a true-root declaration in this file, so F1B's own new type-reference machinery never runs at all for it), already disclosed in the S5-F1B round's own completion report (fixtures/s5-f1b/f1b-report.md).
